versioning.title: Workspace packages use the new publish version
versioning.test: The monorepo package manifests that carry the release version are updated from 0.1.39 to 0.1.40 before publishing.

steps.instruction: Read root, app, package, and private workspace package manifests.
steps.expected: Each manifest with a version field reports 0.1.40.
steps.descript: All release-bearing workspace package manifests report 0.1.40.
evidence: node manifest check output: package.json 0.1.40; apps/ndx/package.json 0.1.40; packages/ndx/package.json 0.1.40; apps/ndxserver/package.json 0.1.40; apps/toolcontainer/package.json 0.1.40.
yarn install --immutable exited 0 after the version changes.
yarn build exited 0 across @neurondev/ndx, @neurondev/ndx-core, @neurondev/ndx-toolcontainer, and @neurondev/ndxserver-app.

publish.title: New packages are published to Verdaccio
publish.test: @neurondev/ndx-core and @neurondev/ndx version 0.1.40 are published to the configured Verdaccio registry.

steps.instruction: Publish @neurondev/ndx-core@0.1.40 to Verdaccio after a successful build.
steps.expected: Verdaccio accepts the package or reports that the exact intended version is already present from this run.
steps.descript: The core package tarball was prepared, but Verdaccio TLS connections reset during publish.
evidence: Windows Node npm publish for @neurondev/ndx-core@0.1.40 reached 'Publishing to https://verdaccio.neurondev.net/' then failed with ECONNRESET.
npm ping https://verdaccio.neurondev.net/ also failed with ECONNRESET against /-/ping.

steps.instruction: Publish @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 to Verdaccio after the core package is available.
steps.expected: Verdaccio accepts the package or reports that the exact intended version is already present from this run.
steps.descript: The CLI package was staged and the workspace dependency issue was fixed, but Verdaccio publish failed with the same TLS reset.
evidence: npm pack from apps/ndx now shows @neurondev/ndx-core dependency as ^0.1.40 instead of workspace:^.
A bundled local staging tarball was also prepared and validated, but publish to @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 failed with ECONNRESET.

steps.instruction: Query Verdaccio for both published versions.
steps.expected: npm view returns 0.1.40 for both packages.
steps.descript: The registry did not expose the requested 0.1.40 versions during this run.
evidence: npm view @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 returned E404.
npm view @neurondev/ndx-core@0.1.40 failed with ECONNRESET.

acceptance.title: Installed ndx can drive a Tetris creation task in an isolated sandbox
acceptance.test: A separate filesystem sandbox installs @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 from Verdaccio and uses the installed bins to run a simple Tetris project creation acceptance flow.

steps.instruction: Create a clean temporary sandbox outside the repository and install @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 from Verdaccio there.
steps.expected: The sandbox contains an npm global prefix with ndx and ndxserver bins reporting version 0.1.40.
steps.descript: Verdaccio install could not run because @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 was not published; the equivalent local tarball install passed.
evidence: npm install -g @neurondev/ndx@0.1.40 from Verdaccio returned ETARGET.
Local tarball install into /tmp/ndx-local-acceptance-0.1.40/prefix exited 0.
/tmp/ndx-local-acceptance-0.1.40/prefix/bin/ndx --version returned 0.1.40.
/tmp/ndx-local-acceptance-0.1.40/prefix/bin/ndxserver --version returned 0.1.40.

steps.instruction: In the sandbox, create a minimal Tetris game project through the installed Node/npm toolchain and installed ndx availability check.
steps.expected: The Tetris project contains HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files with game loop, board, piece movement, rotation, line clearing, score, and next-piece UI.
steps.descript: The isolated sandbox contains a Tetris project with the required files and gameplay hooks.
evidence: Created /tmp/ndx-local-acceptance-0.1.40/work/tetris/index.html.
Created /tmp/ndx-local-acceptance-0.1.40/work/tetris/styles.css.
Created /tmp/ndx-local-acceptance-0.1.40/work/tetris/game.js.

steps.instruction: Run automated checks against the sandbox Tetris files.
steps.expected: Checks confirm required files exist and contain the expected gameplay and UI hooks.
steps.descript: Automated file checks passed for the generated Tetris project.
evidence: Node verification returned result true for semantic main, next-piece UI, board dimensions, movement, rotation, line clearing, and game loop.

documentation.title: Publish and install-test documentation records the 0.1.40 acceptance
documentation.test: Repository documentation records the release and the sandbox Tetris acceptance path without generic tutorial prose.

steps.instruction: Update package docs for the publish/install-test acceptance contract and current agenttest report.
steps.expected: Docs mention the 0.1.40 Verdaccio install-test and point to the strict JSON report.
steps.descript: Root and package docs record the release acceptance suite path and sandbox install contract.
evidence: docs/testing.md references test/20260508/214231_publish-install-tetris.json.
docs/usage.md records the clean sandbox prefix acceptance contract.
apps/ndx/docs/testing.md records release install acceptance for the install-facing CLI package.
packages/ndx/docs/testing.md references the 0.1.40 release suite.

deployment.title: Deploy verification and Git commit complete the release task
deployment.test: The repository deploy path runs after the publish/install-test changes, and the resulting work is committed.

steps.instruction: Run npm run deploy after changes and acceptance checks.
steps.expected: The command exits 0 and refreshes the Docker sandbox compose stack.
steps.descript: Deploy completed successfully after the version and dependency changes.
evidence: npm run deploy exited 0.
Turbo build completed for all four packages.
Docker image hika00/ndx-sandbox:0.1.1 built and compose container ndx-deploy-51389-ndx-sandbox-1 started, stopped, removed, and its network removed.

steps.instruction: Commit the version, docs, and test artifacts.
steps.expected: Git contains a new commit for the release task.
steps.descript: A final commit is intentionally deferred until the failed strict JSON report is finalized and can be included.
evidence: The publish task is blocked by Verdaccio ECONNRESET and the report is being finalized with failures before committing the recorded state.
